title: Steelman before you object
copy: State the strongest version of a position before explaining where you differ.

title: Disagree with the position, not the person
copy: Question claims, reasons, and consequences without assigning motives or character.

title: Make room, then take room
copy: Notice how much you have spoken; invite others in and contribute when your view is missing.

title: Ask before you assume
copy: When a claim surprises you, seek the experience or reasoning behind it.

title: Name uncertainty
copy: Say what you know, what you infer, and what would change your confidence.

title: Change your mind out loud
copy: Treat revision as part of serious inquiry, and say what moved you.
